identity: Arabic translation of a Western academic art-history monograph: Francois Quiviger (فرانسوا كيفيجيه), 'Leonardo da Vinci: Self, Art and Nature' (ليوناردو دافينشي / الذات والفن والطبيعة), translated by ناصر مصطفى أبو الهيجاء, reviewed by د أحمد خريس. Tokens 0-29 are title-page front matter on seven separate <NL> lines (author, title, subtitle, translator credit, reviewer credit, chapter number, chapter title). Tokens 31-649 are the opening of Chapter One, on Leonardo's birth and rural childhood, the move to Florence, and his apprenticeship in Verrocchio's workshop. Scholarly apparatus is present and confirms the genre: footnote markers (1 at index 197, 2 at index 369), artist life-dates (1435 1488), work dates (1467, 1472), a Latin-script gloss (madonnas at 459), and an internal figure cross-reference (انظر الصورتين رقم 27 و 28). Register = translated expository / encyclopedic art-historical nonfiction: my doctrine sections B, L and N, i.e. the same family as doc_0de3fe1bcb6c (Tulunid art history) and doc_085c979b884f (encyclopedia), the two documents where I over-cut worst in batch 2.
law: Two unit systems in one document. (a) FRONT MATTER is layout-indexed: one <NL> line = one segment, entire. A credit line never splits, and an honorific welds to the name it introduces (مراجعة د أحمد خريس is one unit). The only boundary available inside a front-matter line is a LAYOUT colon in a title or heading. (b) THE BODY is punctuation-indexed at the printed full stop, and this register carries the longest units in the corpus: 25-45 tokens, measured here at a mean of 32. Connectives are not boundaries and never constitute a reason to cut: و, ف, ثم, لكن / ولكن, غير أن, بيد أن, حيث, في حين, إذ, comparative كما, وذلك, فضلا عن, مثل, وإن all weld. Neither are comma-lists, name lists, appositions, Latin-script glosses, parenthesised life-dates, work dates and figure references, numbers, or trailing subordinate and circumstantial clauses. A cut must be licensed by a positive mark: an asyndetic verb-initial proposition with a fresh topic NP, وقد / ولقد + perfect launching a new predication on a re-established topic, a fronted prepositional phrase with a re-named subject, an additive كما + finite verb, or an outright topic reset. Default at every remaining site is WELD.
reasoning: CALIBRATION BEFORE SEGMENTATION (LAW 6, the only law never falsified). This is the register in which I posted F1 61.0 and 70.6 in batch 2 by over-cutting 2-3x, so I fixed the target band first: 25-45 tokens. The body is 611 tokens across 9 paragraphs; I placed 19 body segments, mean 32.2 tokens, which sits mid-band. Everything below is an argument for a cut against a standing default of weld. || FRONT MATTER. Index 19, مراجعة د أحمد خريس, is a token-for-token match with doctrine A1, which records doc_566d3db2b5c9 @14 as a FALSE CUT with gold مراجعة د أحمد خريس as one unit: the honorific د welds. Same for ترجمة ناصر مصطفى أبو الهيجاء at 14 (cf. doc_51f6f776f3c7 @9, also a recorded false cut). The subtitle الذات والفن والطبيعة is a و-list, one segment (LAW 3). Index 27 is my one front-matter gamble: السنوات الأولى في فلورنسا and التعليم والتكوين sit on ONE line with no <NL> between them, so they were joined by punctuation, and a chapter title-plus-subtitle colon is the paradigm case of the LAYOUT colon that A4 preserves as a boundary (confirmed gold doc_c188bbc9702e @38/@40, كسلان جدا | حول العالم). Marked lo because my only precedent is a title quoted inside running prose, not a standalone heading line, and heading cells elsewhere (section J) are single segments. || Index 50, في حين — WELD, and here doctrine pays for itself. B2 records the near-identical false cut in this very register: doc_085c979b884f @304, gold ...أبولينير في حين كان تأثير السوبرماتية أكبر وأوسع انتشارا. Same construction, في حين كان plus a contrastive clause. So 31-74 stays one 44-token sentence even though cutting there would have produced a tidy 20 + 24. || Index 74, مثلت — CUT, hi. The strongest positive mark in the document: a verb-initial clause with a brand-new topic NP (طفولته الريفية) and NO connective whatsoever. Arabic expository prose links clauses inside a sentence with و or ف; asyndesis is the residue of a full stop. This does not collide with LAW 3 or P1, where asyndetic chains weld, because those are telegraphic reportage clauses and comma-list items, not a self-contained proposition in a monograph. || Indices 83, 93, 101 — all WELD (ولا بد أنها, ويمكن القول إن, فقد أمضى). Batch 2 killed the new-argument test; ويمكن القول is و plus a modal assertion frame, and فقد is explanatory, which LAW 2 says counts against cutting. 75-114 comes to 40 tokens, in band. || Index 114, وحين توفي عنه جداه — CUT, med. B3 warns that a fronted وعندما does not open a segment, so the connective is expressly not my reason. My reason is that welding leaves 75-139 at 65 tokens, far outside any register in my table, and that this is the one genuine topic reset in the paragraph: nature-as-first-teacher gives way to the grandparents' death, the remarried father, and the move to Florence, with all new participants. حيث at 127 and فيما at 130 weld under B2 and LAW 4. || Index 168, ومما لا ريب فيه أن — CUT, med, and I am knowingly overriding a close analogue. doc_4259e5d2a449 @546 gold WELDS ولا مشاحة في أن, the same و plus certainty-frame plus أن shape, and that was one of my batch-2 false cuts. I cut anyway because welding leaves P2 as a single 57-token unit above the 45 ceiling, because 141-168 | 169-197 is 28 | 29 and a textbook profile, and because the لكن clause at 157 closes the preceding thought rather than opening one (B4: ولكن welds backwards, so in this register it ends sentences). The essay register of doc_4259e5d2a449 runs longer and looser than academic translation. Logged as a deliberate test of that override. || Index 224, وقد اعتلى — CUT, hi. My one surviving و-shaped cue (LAW 1, roughly 80 percent), and the golds cited for it come from doc_085c979b884f, this exact register (وقد ظهرت, وقد تمحور, وقد كانت). It also falls immediately after the close of a مثل-list (الرسم والنحت والعمارة والهندسة), and lists end at stops. || Index 242, وفي تاريخ الفن — CUT, med. و plus a fronted prepositional phrase plus fresh predication with the subject re-named (يمثل فروكيو). Welding gives 58 tokens; cutting gives 18 | 40. Inside 243-282 I welded everything: the four-name founders list (مازاتشو ولورينتسو جبرتي ودوناتيلو), the بين ... وبين pair, and وذلك عبر تلامذة فروكيو with its three-name apposition. That is LAW 3 (the thirteen-name run in doc_0de3fe1bcb6c, my single most expensive error) plus LAW 4 (وذلك, doc_2fabc1ccf342 @20). || Index 308, وتتضمن — WELD, against instinct. Section L names this exact verb family (وتشمل, وهي) as continuations I keep absorbing and then wrongly cutting, and records that batch-2 gold welds them. So P4 splits only once. Index 329, كما تشمل — CUT, med: with 308 welded this is the only available site in an 86-token paragraph, and it yields 46 | 40. Inside 330-369 nothing cuts: بدأ العمل به 1467 is a parenthetical date, ونصب الفروسية is a second مثل-list item, and وكان قد شرع في تصميمه is a trailing circumstantial (LAW 4). || Index 388, كما اقترب — WELD, and I accept the asymmetry with 329 knowingly. The two are structurally identical: additive كما plus finite verb with an elided subject. At 329 the split was forced by paragraph length; at 388 welding gives 371-408 = 38 tokens, comfortably in band, and 408 is the better-marked site in P5. LAW 0-double-prime applies: coin flip, do not cut. If gold cuts 388 I take one miss, which is the cheaper error given a 22:1 over-cut history. || Index 408, ولقد شكل — CUT, hi: emphatic لقد plus perfect, and a clean topic reset to the Colleoni monument as the model Leonardo tried to surpass. Index 420, بيد أنه — WELD: same family as غير أن and إلا أن, resolved in T1 as welding subordinators; يدعى حصان ليوناردو أيضا at 430 is a parenthetical gloss (A2b). || Indices 449, 459, 500 — all WELD: فهي is a ف continuation (LAW 2), madonnas is a Latin-script gloss (A2b), and كما في نحت التماثيل is كما plus a prepositional phrase, comparative rather than additive, which is my discriminator for this connective. Index 478, وقد اتسعت — CUT, hi: وقد plus perfect, a real shift from minerals-as-theme to Leonardo's own expanding knowledge, and the preceding unit closes on the figure-reference parenthetical انظر الصورتين رقم 27 و 28, inside which I did not cut (A2: never split a number). 37 | 27. || P7 (507-535) I left whole at 29 tokens: وكان أول من جرب is و with the same subject, and وإن لم ينجح دائما في ذلك is a trailing concessive (LAW 4). || Index 550, وقد هجر — WELD, and this is my proposed resolution of open tension T6. وقد plus perfect CUTS when it launches a fresh predication on a re-established topic (indices 224, 478); it WELDS when it reads as a pluperfect or hal elaborating the noun phrase just named. That is the case here, since فروكيو has been pronominal throughout the clause (أنه, لكنه), and it is exactly the shape of the T6 counter-example doc_3484c02411e9 @289. || Index 559, غير أن فروكيو — CUT, med, and I am knowingly cutting at a subordinator B2 marks as welding. The reason is not the غير أن. It is that the preceding 23-token sentence is closed; that the subject is RE-NAMED (فروكيو) after three pronominal references, which is a new-sentence signal; and that T1's own resolution states the boundary is the preceding full stop rather than the subordinator. B2's cited gold, doc_566d3db2b5c9 @505, is غير أن in its true subordinating sense (except that), whereas this is an adversative pivot rebutting Vasari's verdict. Logged for the next batch. فقد كان مبرزا at 571 welds (T4). || Index 584, ومع فن السكب — CUT, med: و plus fronted prepositional phrase plus a subject change from Verrocchio to Leonardo, lifting السكب out of the immediately preceding list to frame a new assertion. Structurally parallel to index 242. || Index 598, ليس هذا فحسب — CUT, lo, my weakest cut. In favour: zero connective, and a fixed sentence-initial rhetorical frame. Every one of my 354 batch-2 false cuts was at a connective and none at an asyndetic discourse formula. Against: it leaves 585-598 at only 14 tokens, my shortest body unit. Index 610, وعي — WELD: وعي بخواص النار والدخان followed by وعي أرسى is comma apposition, LAW 3. || P9 (624-649) left whole at 26 tokens: the مثل-list and the فضلا عن tail both weld. || SWING CHECK (checklist item 9).
